[C] FloatingBox variants
|-- FloatingBox = FloatingPane | FloatingBoxArrow
|   |-- FloatingPane: DisplayNodeBase + one pane variant
|   |   |-- id / childIds[] / expansion
|   |   |-- position { x,y } / bounds { width,height }
|   |   |-- coordinateSpace: canvas | viewport
|   |   |-- geometryPolicy: placement automatic | manual
|   |   |   `-- sizing: content | fixed
|   |   |-- expandedGeometry?              restore on expand
|   |   `-- pane alternatives
|   |       |-- SelectionRegion            kind: 'selection'
|   |       |   |-- sourceBoxId / sourceContentId / sourceAscii
|   |       |   |-- sourceRevisionId? / rect / selectedIds[]
|   |       |   `-- displayMode stacked | chained / activeChildId?
|   |       |-- ProjectedPane              kind: 'projection'
|   |       |   |-- title / projectionId? / activeChildId?
|   |       |   |-- sourceRevisionId? / targetRevisionId?
|   |       |   `-- content alternatives
|   |       |       |-- call-tree: result / coverage
|   |       |       |-- compaction: files[]: ProjectedFile
|   |       |       |-- source-code: projectId / sourceId?
|   |       |       |   |-- files[] / sourceFile / scroll?
|   |       |       |   `-- showCompactions / rangeIndex
|   |       |       `-- code-panel: selectionId / panel / scroll?
|   |       |-- ConversationPane           kind: 'conversation'
|   |       |   `-- presentation / thread / canvasAnchor / draft
|   |       `-- DetailPane                 kind: 'detail'
|   |           `-- title / ascii / sectionId?
|   `-- FloatingBoxArrow                   kind: 'arrow'
|       `-- drawEdge(edge, scene, views, cell, endpointBounds)
|-- DisplayState.nodes: FloatingPane; arrows are derived
`-- SelectionRegion: panel context; membership: SelectionState
